items.q: How long is the online course, and how many live hours are there?
items.a: It runs for 20 weeks with 150+ hours of live classes, and every session is recorded so you can catch up anytime.

items.q: What if I miss a live class?
items.a: Rewatch the recording of every session, and ask your mentor your doubts during the next live class or one-to-one.

items.q: Which AI tools will I learn?
items.a: ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Canva AI and Perplexity are used in every module.

items.q: How much does the online course cost?
items.a: The online course fee is ₹20,000 (regular fee ₹25,000, so you save a flat ₹5,000). You can also pay in EMIs of ₹5,000 per month. The Fee Structure section on this page has the details. For help, WhatsApp +91 84619 58162.

items.q: When does the next online batch start, and what are the timings?
items.a: The next online batch starts on 11 November 2026. Live classes run Monday to Saturday, 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, and each online batch has 30 seats.

items.q: Can I try a live session before I enrol?
items.a: Yes. You can sit in on a live session before you decide and ask the current batch what they think.

items.q: How many projects will I work on?
items.a: You work on 15+ industry projects and live campaigns in accounts with real numbers, and end with a free portfolio website.

items.q: Will I get help with my resume and interviews?
items.a: Yes. The course includes mock interviews, ad-account audits and case-study rounds with mentors, plus placement support.

items.q: Which jobs can I apply for after the course?
items.a: Roles such as Digital Marketing Executive, SEO Executive, Social Media Executive, Performance Marketer and Content Marketer.
